 Star Wars: Battlefront 3 Actively In Development From EA DICE And Respawn
 by Jordan King | Published on 21st October 2026 at 7.26pm Follow Empire on Google The world of Star Wars gaming is in pretty rude health just about now. In the last couple of months alone, we've gotten two of the best-reviewed games to come out of that galaxy far, far away in ages in the form of XCOM style tactics joint Star Wars: Zero Company and high-octane podracing banger Star Wars: Galactic Racer . Now, after weeks of whispers and years of rumours, Variety is reporting that a long clamoured for new title — Star Wars: Battlefront 3 — is in active development at EA DICE and Respawn.
 News of a third game in the modern era Battlefront revival — started with 2015's Star Wars: Battlefront , and continued with similarly ingeniously titled 2017 follow-up Star Wars: Battlefront II — will no doubt be music to the ears of Star Wars fans. Battlefront II , which overcame micro-transaction based controversy upon release to become a feature-rich and worthy sequel to DICE's 2015 resurrection of their own shooter franchise, received its last update six years ago, meaning virtually the entire Disney+ era of Star Wars — including Andor , The Mandalorian & Grogu , Ahsoka , Skeleton Crew , The Bad Batch , Maul: Shadow Lord , and more — has been left untouched and untapped in the non- Fortnite gaming world. Presumably, any new game would rectify that dearth of up-to-date content, and potentially feature maps and characters from new and upcoming projects too, like Star Wars: Starfighter (and, of course, Glup Shitto of the moment, Biddy Blas !)
 News of Battlefront 3 being in active development comes on what has otherwise been another rough day in the gaming industry, one which has seen EA confirm that 3% of its current workforce (approximately 14,000 employees) are being laid off and that legendary studio BioWare — of Mass Effect , Knights Of The Old Republic , and Dragon Age fame — is being shut down. But hey, at least we're getting Battlefront 3 , a new Jedi series game, and that Iron Man one, too, eh? Silver linings and all that...
